info.name: OrderFlow GraphQL — local smoke flow
info.description: Sequential synthetic-data checks for the NestJS GraphQL interface. Run in order against the local NestJS service. Concurrency and REST comparison are covered by the integration suites.

body.raw: {"query":"mutation ($input: CreateProductInput!) { createProduct(input: $input) { id name active unitPriceMinor currency stockAvailable } }","variables":{"input":{"name":"GraphQL Postman {{$guid}}","unitPriceMinor":1250,"stockAvailable":5}}}

exec: pm.test('GraphQL product created with five units', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.errors).to.eql(undefined); const p = body.data.createProduct; pm.expect(p.stockAvailable).to.eql(5); pm.expect(p.unitPriceMinor).to.eql(1250); pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', p.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderKey', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}')); });

body.raw: {"query":"mutation ($input: CreateOrderInput!) { createOrder(input: $input) { id status currency totalMinor items { productId unitPriceMinor quantity lineTotalMinor } } }","variables":{"input":{"idempotencyKey":"{{orderKey}}","items":[{"productId":"{{productId}}","quantity":2}]}}}

exec: pm.test('GraphQL order reserved at captured price', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.errors).to.eql(undefined); const o = body.data.createOrder; pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('reserved'); pm.expect(o.totalMinor).to.eql(2500); pm.expect(o.items[0].unitPriceMinor).to.eql(1250); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', o.id); });

pm.test('GraphQL replay returns the same order', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.errors).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(body.data.createOrder.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });

item.name: 04 Reject changed request under same key

exec: pm.test('GraphQL key conflict is coded', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const e = pm.response.json().errors[0].extensions; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql(409); });

pm.test('GraphQL detail query returns the reserved order', function () { const o = pm.response.json().data.order; pm.expect(o.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('reserved'); pm.expect(o.totalMinor).to.eql(2500); });

pm.test('GraphQL stock is deducted once', function () { const p = pm.response.json().data.products.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); pm.expect(p.stockAvailable).to.eql(3); });

pm.test('GraphQL cancellation restores stock', function () { const p = pm.response.json().data.products.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); pm.expect(p.stockAvailable).to.eql(5); });
